description: This multi-layered pie chart, or sunburst chart, represents a hierarchical categorization of analysis types, consisting of an inner ring with four primary categories and an outer ring subdividing those into sixteen specific subcategories, totaling twenty distinct segments. The inner ring includes the light blue-grey "Semantic Layer (41.2%)", the dark blue "Perception" layer (which appears to occupy approximately 40% of the chart, though its exact percentage and full label are obscured by a grey rectangular visual artifact), the light grey "Cultural Layer (14.1%)", and the medium blue "Signal Layer (4.3%)". The outer ring segments share the general color palette of their parent inner segment and do not display numerical percentages. The Semantic Layer is subdivided into three light blue-grey slices: "Content Analysis" (visually the largest outer segment), "Emotion & Intention", and "Speaker Analysis". The Perception layer is divided into six medium blue slices, appearing roughly in descending order of size counter-clockwise: "Environmental Perception & Reasoning", "Counting & Statistics", "Music Theory", "Correlation Analysis", "Temporal Analysis", and "Spatial Analysis". The Cultural Layer splits into four light grey slices: "Professional Knowl & Reasoning", "Culture of Speaker", "Imagination", and "Asthetic Analysis". Finally, the Signal Layer contains three medium blue slices: "Acoustic Quality Analysis", "Anomaly Detection", and "Audio Difference Analysis". The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, labels are placed directly inside the segments, with the exception of two very narrow outer slices, "Asthetic Analysis" and "Audio Difference Analysis", which are labeled outside the chart with grey lines pointing to their respective segments. There are no exploded or offset slices.
